reasons: c64 full-width service cost exceeds the locked target before fill, queue, fallback, or policy overhead.
c96 is the only full-width economic preselection, but its 6.4 req/s minimum fill rate for a 10-second oldest-cohort wait exceeds its 2.126 req/s maximum service capacity.
At the finite 2.0 req/s planning point, the exact timeout policy charges c32 fallback and reaches the economic and completion gates, but queue p95 exceeds 10 seconds.

required_fragments: FULL_DECODE_ONLY mode: Capture full cudagraph for decode batches only.
Mixed prefill-decode batches are run without cudagraphs.

physical_hypothesis.falsifier: The route fails if exact c96 weight/launch amortization cannot coexist with a stable finite arrival rate and queue p95 <=10 seconds.
physical_hypothesis.mechanism: c64/c96 remain one M-tile for ordinary decode at tile-M 128, so N-grid wave counts do not increase; wider batches amortize one FP8 transformer stream, one BF16 head stream, and launches across more requests while exact compute, KV, attention, and non-GEMM bytes/request remain charged.
physical_hypothesis.resource_expected_to_move: FP8/BF16 HBM weight bytes and device launches per request.

policy.admission: FCFS over independent immutable c32 cohorts; dispatch exactly three cohorts as c96 when all are waiting.
policy.drain: When the oldest waiting c32 cohort reaches 10 seconds without three cohorts present, dispatch that cohort unchanged as c32.
policy.graph_and_padding: Use enforce_eager for the screen, charge every launch, and execute exact unpadded token rows. Current generated graph sizes include 96, but no graph or padding credit is taken.
policy.implementation_binding: SchedulerConfig.scheduler_cls resolves a custom class; Scheduler owns FCFS waiting/running queues and max_num_seqs; GPUModelRunner consumes the emitted per-request token map and recognizes an exact uniform decode when total tokens equal query length times requests.
policy.prefill_decode_barrier: The adapter must hold already-prefilled members at the cohort boundary until all 96 prompts complete, because stock Scheduler prioritizes RUNNING before WAITING and otherwise forms mixed prefill/decode steps.
policy.sampling_and_semantics: Unchanged per-request sampling and output ownership; no request, token, layer, parameter, KV row, attention pair, or head row is shared or dropped.
policy.source_complete_status: source_bound_negative; the adapter contract and exact consumer path are complete enough to evaluate, but no runtime patch is promoted because the planning queue gate is physically impossible.

queue_impossibility_bound.proof: Three c32 cohorts are required. At any stable rate lambda <= c96 capacity, the first cohort waits at least 64/lambda >= 64/capacity; satisfying 64/lambda <=10 requires lambda >=6.4, which is above capacity.

semantic_and_padding_accounting.fp8_kv_writes: included within the parent non-GEMM conversion/write byte ledger and resident KV capacity; no write is credited away

line_items.name: prefill_fp8_transformer_linears
line_items.rule: Exact fresh-token FLOPs at settled 20% FP8 efficiency versus one 29.397-GB stream per 8,192-token chunk; charge the maximum.

line_items.name: prefill_hybrid_attention
line_items.rule: max(compute, unique K/V HBM); K/V tiles are not charged once per query pair

line_items.name: prefill_norm_activation_conversion
line_items.rule: separate unfused bytes at 30% HBM; GEMM weight/input/output traffic is not charged again

line_items.name: ordinary_decode_fp8_transformer_linears
line_items.rule: One exact FP8 transformer stream per width-wide decode step, zero L2 credit, versus exact FLOPs at settled 20% FP8 efficiency.

line_items.name: ordinary_decode_bf16_tied_head
line_items.rule: One exact BF16 tied-head stream per width-wide decode step versus exact FLOPs at settled 20% BF16 efficiency.

line_items.name: ordinary_decode_attention_kv
line_items.rule: 358 exact context positions, zero L2 credit

line_items.name: ordinary_decode_norm_activation_conversion
line_items.rule: separate non-GEMM bytes

line_items.name: target_verification_transformer
line_items.rule: Preserve all 15 conservative target cycles and 12 rows/request; exact FLOPs at 20% FP8 versus one transformer stream per cycle.

line_items.name: target_verification_bf16_tied_head
line_items.rule: Preserve 12 semantic BF16 head calls per cycle; no grouped-head reuse credit.

line_items.name: target_verification_attention_kv
line_items.rule: 12 query rows share one compulsory K/V read per request/cycle; no L2 credit

line_items.name: launch_reserve
line_items.rule: 18 launches/layer plus target-head calls; eager/no graph-elision credit makes token padding exactly zero.

line_items.name: scheduler_service_reserve
line_items.rule: fixed inferred reserve; must be replaced by endpoint evidence
